title: Billing Resolution Timeframes: Patient Invoices & Statements
content:
Patient Invoices & Statements sets, per billing class, how long after the first statement date a billing dispute can be filed, how long each kind of hold lasts, how quickly a dispute is decided, and the estimate-variance threshold.

| | Self-Pay Patient Invoice | Consumer Test Purchase Invoice | Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | Medicaid Copay Invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dispute filing window, calendar days after the first statement date | 120 | 120 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Billing-dispute hold, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Financial-assistance review hold, calendar days | 60 | 0 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Insurance-reprocessing hold, calendar days | 45 | 0 | 45 | 60 | 45 | 45 |
| Extensions of a hold of the same cause, at most | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Dispute decided within, business days | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Estimate-variance threshold (USD) | 400.00 | 400.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Estimate-variance settlement | Adjust to estimate | Adjust to estimate | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |

## Definitions

- **Dispute filing window**: the calendar days after the first statement date within which a billing dispute is accepted.
- **Billing-dispute hold**: the calendar days an invoice stays on hold for one dispute or one review cause.
- **Financial-assistance review hold**: the calendar days an invoice stays on hold while a financial-assistance application is pending; 0 means no hold.
- **Insurance-reprocessing hold**: the calendar days an invoice stays on hold while a claim for it is corrected, appealed or reprocessed; 0 means no hold.
- **Extensions**: the number of times a hold of the same cause may be extended.
- **Dispute decided within**: the business days within which a billing dispute is decided.
- **Estimate-variance threshold**: the amount by which billed self-pay charges must exceed the good faith estimate for an estimate-variance dispute; 0.00 means not applicable.
- **Estimate-variance settlement**: how an eligible estimate-variance dispute is settled — adjust to estimate, or not applicable.

## Points of comparison

- The Self-Pay Patient Invoice and the Consumer Test Purchase Invoice accept disputes for 120 calendar days after the first statement date; the four insured classes accept them for 180.
- The Out-of-Network Balance Invoice holds for 60 calendar days during insurance reprocessing; the Self-Pay, Insured Patient Responsibility, Medicare Beneficiary Liability and Medicaid Copay classes hold for 45; the Consumer Test Purchase Invoice shows 0, meaning no hold.
- The Consumer Test Purchase Invoice shows 0 for the financial-assistance review hold, meaning no hold for that cause.
